assumptions.statement: The repository-maintained provisional site and key-area polygons are used only for generation, visualization, spatial intake checks, and design discussion.
assumptions.impact: The proposal cannot make official redline, ownership, statutory control, or precise-area claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace the site and key-area polygons when the organizer publishes cleared official geometry, then recompute every dependent layer, metric, figure, HTML page, and PDF.

assumptions.statement: FAR, total floor area, building height, building density, green-space control, setbacks, road redlines, fire access, municipal capacity, and heritage controls are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: All scale and control language is a conceptual reference scheme, not an approved planning condition.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Reconcile the design carriers, land-use partition, roads, constraints, metrics, and drawings with official controls before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: Land-use bands are generated by clipping shared cut lines against the provisional site polygon; buildings, roads, green spaces, public spaces, and phases are design layers inside that constraint.
assumptions.impact: The geometry is auditable and topology-safe for intake, but it is not a cadastral or existing-condition survey.

assumptions.statement: Every AI civic interface has a legibility signal, a consent or opt-out path, a named human steward, and a rollback or low-tech fallback path.
assumptions.impact: Scenario usefulness is judged by public recoverability and accountability rather than automation volume.

assumptions.statement: International cases are mechanism references only. Their governance, procurement, software, and legal contexts cannot be copied into Haidian without local review.
assumptions.impact: Case studies support comparative reasoning, not claims about local feasibility or endorsement.

assumptions.statement: Scenario cards use public, synthetic, aggregated, or user-provided cleared data; no personal identity, private enterprise data, or covert tracking is required.
assumptions.impact: High-risk services must degrade to human service and stop when consent, data quality, safety, or rights conditions fail.

assumptions.statement: The Jingzhang heritage line and cultural narrative are treated as public-history and design clues until official heritage inventory, protection boundaries, and interpretation permissions are available.
assumptions.impact: No feature is labeled a heritage protection line, historic building, or approved cultural installation solely from this proposal.

assumptions.statement: Steward roles, maintenance funds, activity permissions, and service hours are proposed operating mechanisms, not confirmed government budgets, contracts, or event schedules.
assumptions.impact: Permanent works require ownership, procurement, safety, accessibility, and maintenance confirmation before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The six sectional-perspective and pedestrian-experience images in assets/figures/concepts/ are AI-generated narrative illustrations used to make the three key-area actions understandable.
assumptions.impact: They are not site photographs, surveys, fixed geometry, engineering sections, official materials, or evidence of existing conditions; coordinates, routes, dimensions, and functional labels remain governed by the package figures and GeoJSON.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: If cleared site photography, survey material, or approved design imagery is supplied, replace the concept illustrations and regenerate the bilingual figures, HTML pages, PDFs, and manifest hashes.

assumptions.statement: Amap POI and walking-route results are used only to sanity-check naming, transit adjacency, and the plausibility of the conceptual slow-spine narrative.
assumptions.impact: Map search results do not set the provisional boundary, define land use, replace an accessibility audit, or change any submitted geometry or formal metric.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: If the organizer supplies cleared spatial or transport data, replace the map QA observations with that source and rerun the spatial, metric, drawing, and professional checks.
